visual_identity.core_identity: A heavy corrosive dungeon ooze that flows as an irregular low mass and destroys metal on contact.
visual_identity.silhouette: Broad spreading puddle-like mass with lobed edges and sagging drips around obstacles.
visual_identity.body_shape: Amorphous viscous mass with no fixed anatomy; shape conforms around bars and floor openings.
visual_identity.surface: Dark-associated ooze represented by strong outer contour and sparse internal lines, never solid black fill.

scene_identity.natural_posture: Low spreading mass fully supported by floor, grate, wall base, or other contacted architecture.
